text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after training,
while walking through the shopping district with Rhein Kraft—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I found you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look! It looks like we can use the lottery ticket
we got at the shop earlier right here!
choice_data_list: I'm glad we took a detour.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it really is.
To think they're holding such an extravagant lottery.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we got a craving for ice creamâª
Wouldn't it be amazing if it turned into a hot spring?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right,
let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft pumped herself up
and spun the raffle wheel's lever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah-wah~~?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-saaan!
T-There's really ice cream in the hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, waaah~...!
Now what should we do about this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Does this mean... we're going to be totally immersed in ice cream?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, guess not~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring is so nice, isn't it!
We can totally relax and get all warm and toasty♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right, 
I have to make sure I definitely don't lose it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Let's hug it all the way home! Tight squeeze!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
we've arrived safely~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to bring back
the hot springs trip ticket!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft literally hugged the hot springs trip ticket tightly all the way back to the academy.
choice_data_list: You really want to go that badly, huh?
You really want to go that badly, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because I want to make it a present for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Right now is kinda crunch time for us! But still..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Once I get tons of results
and bring so much excitement to the Tiara route,
after that...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take it easy
with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, of course I would!
After all, you're my Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
By then, I think I'll be
at least a little more dependable, so...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You can just relax and rest,
without having to think about anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Let's go on a chill, cozy reward trip together!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?
Doesn't it get you excited?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While touched by Rhein Kraft's kindness...
the hot spring trip ticket became a reward
saved for the distant future.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a Carrot Hamburger Steak!
And it's a special grade one, too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Is it kind of strong?
It's definitely gonna be delicious, whoaaa...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *drool*
choice_data_list: Let's hurry home and get something to eat, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we returned to the academy...
and had the cafeteria cook up some carrot hamburg steaks.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
It's starting to smell so good!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Will it start soon?
Is it almost time~?♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"It must be sizzling right about now...
*drools*"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~...
Is it ready yet, is it ready yet...♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, she smiled.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"No fair, Trainer!
You have to get excited with me!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm,
it's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, it's here, it's here~!
Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~,
so yummy~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Line Craft stuffed her mouth full of hamburger steak.
Seeing her look so happy warmed my heart completely."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hyaa~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: There's so much~! This truly is... a mountain of food.
choice_data_list: You can really eat a lot, huh.
You can really eat a lot, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Right!
We did it~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, taking turns carrying
as many carrots as we could hold—

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
So many carrots~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my!
You've got an eye for quality."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I won it in the lottery.
Pretty amazing, right!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
Ooh, it looks so shiny and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look, look,
doesn't it look delicious!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Shall I give some
to you two as well?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
There were so many of them!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, big sisters!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Enjoy the food, okay!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
our mountain turned into a little hill, didn't it?
choice_data_list: Still, you looked like you were having fun handing them out.
Still, you looked like you were having fun handing them out.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's fun, you know~
After all...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: “Because I was able to pass on my own happiness to the children.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she said that, watching over the backs of the frolicking children... Rhein Kraft's expression was exceedingly gentle.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: It's a carrot!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even just grazing it makes me happy.
Oh, let's make a quick detour on the way!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We can get them baked somewhere...
and have a mini picnic!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, smells so good!
Looks delicious...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Trainer, you go ahead and take the first bite!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still,
that's just, you really shouldn't...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure about this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *Chomp*♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: A-A miss, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No way.
My ice cream got all over the tissue……
choice_data_list: I don't think that's right, though...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, but still,
we can always use tissues...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
If we just make a hot spring out of tissues...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, figures that was impossible.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring... Hot spriiiing...
Hauuu~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Line Craft was disappointed after all...
